item.title: [Message Center] MC1530609 Engage plugin for Copilot Cowork and Autopilot: General availability
item.description:
The Engage plugin for Copilot Cowork and Autopilot will be generally available worldwide by mid-November 2026. It integrates Engage conversations into Copilot workflows, enabling users to access, summarize, and interact with community content without switching apps. The plugin is off by default and controlled by administrators.
